text: Sample Health Shield is an invented indemnity health policy used only to test this software. It covers hospitalization due to illness or accident.
label: Section 0 - Introduction

text: The policy covers persons aged 18 to 65 years at entry. Children from 91 days can be covered with a parent.
label: Section 1 - Eligibility

text: The base cover pays the expenses listed in Sections 3.1 to 3.3 up to the Sum Insured.
label: Section 3 - Base Cover

text: Room rent, nursing, ICU charges and surgeon fees are paid for a hospital stay of at least 24 hours.
label: Section 3.1 - Hospitalization Expenses

text: Medical expenses incurred in the 30 days before admission are paid if the hospitalization claim is admissible.
label: Section 3.2 - Pre-hospitalization Expenses

text: Medical expenses incurred in the 60 days after discharge are paid if the hospitalization claim is admissible.
label: Section 3.3 - Post-hospitalization Expenses

text: The following optional covers can be bought for an extra premium.
label: Section 4 - Optional Covers

text: The Wellness Bonus increases the Sum Insured by 10% for each claim-free year, up to 50%.
label: Section 4.1 - Wellness Bonus

text: The policy does not pay for the following:
label: Section 10 - Exclusions

text: Treatment of the conditions listed below is covered only after 24 months of continuous cover:
label: Section 10.1 - Waiting Periods

text: Cataract; Hernia; Kidney stones; Joint replacement unless caused by an accident.
label: Section 10.1 - Waiting Periods - list

text: Cosmetic surgery, experimental treatment and injuries from war are never covered.
label: Section 10.2 - Permanent Exclusions

text: Notify the insurer within 48 hours of an emergency admission and submit the claim documents within 15 days of discharge.
label: Section 11 - Claims
